scope: G4 profiles subject to the approved observation-aware privacy construction
text: The G4 privacy construction MUST include every declared program field, root argument, component side/status, ReadObject metadata cell, operation, expression branch, parameter/call/control relationship, governing owning schema, public PI alias and source-required producer observation/custody path; absent source completeness MUST remain an admission failure.

scope: G4 profiles subject to the approved observation-aware privacy construction
text: Every required observer and coalition visibility assessment MUST be independently source-established for the exact regenerated graph; missing or unknown visibility MUST fail, and a caller-supplied completeness flag MUST NOT substitute for that evidence.

scope: G4 profiles subject to the approved observation-aware privacy construction
text: Cross-context correlation assessment MUST use the independently established observable graph for each required observer coalition, preserve the existing permitted constant-equality exception only in that assessment, and include equality of values visible to that coalition.

scope: G4 profiles subject to the approved observation-aware privacy construction
text: Actor-reconstruction assessment MUST retain the complete regenerated graph, including confidential, non-observed and permitted constant-equality edges, without visibility filtering.

scope: G4 profiles subject to the approved observation-aware privacy construction
text: The observation-aware correction MUST NOT introduce public-linkage exceptions, suppress existing public PI, convert changing roots or action-local values into generation constants, or waive the unchanged public uniqueness and actor-protection obligations.
